whatThisPluginAdds.text: Site Monitor is a Pipeline package for planned external uptime, SSL certificate, domain-expiry, and incident monitoring.

surfaceOutcome.text: It is not supported as an installed operator surface yet. Its dashboard, resources, commands, schedule, and schema remain review-required until certification and host-install verification are complete.

developers.text: The review scaffold contains typed check Actions, an outbound-URL guard, queued target jobs, models, and manifest contributions for certification work.

teams.text: Teams should not depend on this package in production yet. Its intended outcome is one place to review external checks and incidents after certification is complete.
